  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is neutral or negative).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative signals (e.g., -0.20 or -1.00) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment history includes multiple consecutive positive signals (e.g., 0.00/0.33) followed by a drop.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment shifts; use 3-5 day rolling average to smooth sentiment influence.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, reduce forecast by 3-5% for next period to account for underestimation bias.",
    "When sentiment is positive (0.00/0.33) but price declines, reduce forecast by 5-10% to avoid overconfidence bias.",
    "For long-term horizon (e.g., 30-day), apply a 10-15% downward correction if true outcome is consistently 5-10% below forecast."
  ]
}
